title: Need feedback on a gamejam game
author: yukajii
selftext:
I'm making a game for a gamejam about a space cowboy starting a farm on a planet overrun by giant native bugs. It's a top-down/twin-stick shooter with base building and tower defense elements, closest popular reference being The Riftbreaker.

I don't want to keep adding content and instead focus on polishing what I have. But I ran out of friends to ask to give feedback...

So I hope you guys can help. I welcome any feedback, but especially on:

1. Is it clear what to do in the game? Are tutorials enough?

2. Is UI clear and comfortable?

3. How far in the game did you get, and what made you stop?

It's playable in browser, keyboard and mouse is best, but also has controller support:

[https://homestead-pt-x7m3.pages.dev/](https://homestead-pt-x7m3.pages.dev/)

Thanks a bunch in advance!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/yukajii please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: How long did you have to work on this? It looks quite good so far. I like the rural space theme.

replies.author: yukajii
replies.body:
Thanks!

Since last weekend. Ages for a vibe-coded game, and barely a proof of concept for a traditional one :)

Did you have a chance to play it? Anything specific you can share?

replies.author: Maple-Syrup89
replies.body: Not yet, working on my game pretty heavily has consumed my time, but I will check it out soon.
